baseBodyPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent spritesheet for a 2D Kyokushin fighting game, same illustrated arcade art style as the supplied reference sheet: hand-inked dark contours, warm skin, realistic athletic anatomy, off-white karate gi with blue-gray cloth shadows, small black Kyokushin chest calligraphy, bare feet. Input reference: visual style only.
Produce ONE square 2048x2048 RGBA transparent image with EXACTLY 36 separate complete full-body figures in a perfectly regular 6 columns by 6 rows grid. Each cell has generous empty transparent margin, no figure crosses its cell. All characters same adult person, body proportions and scale; never crop hands/feet. No ground shadow, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no background, no props, no extra effects. Character has completely BALD bare scalp because hairstyle/head will be supplied by separate game layers. Every pose wears a vivid solid CYAN turquoise belt (#00c8ce) with dark teal folds, waist knot and TWO long hanging ends, no colored stripes. This is a technical recoloring palette.
All poses attack toward the viewer's RIGHT; mostly three-quarter side view. Match anatomy and details consistently. Pose order, left-to-right then top-to-bottom is mandatory:
Row 1: neutral fighting guard; forward walking step left foot; forward walking step right foot; forward low dash; rising jump knees flexed; descending jump ready to land.
Row 2: lead straight punch chamber; full extended lead straight punch RIGHT; reverse punch chamber torso twists; full extended reverse punch RIGHT; crouched body uppercut chamber; short upward body punch extension RIGHT.
Row 3: hook punch chamber; hook punch extension RIGHT; low round kick knee chamber; low round kick extended RIGHT below waist; front kick knee chamber; front kick fully extended RIGHT horizontally.
Row 4: high roundhouse kick chamber; high roundhouse kick fully extended RIGHT at head height; spinning back kick torso turns; spinning back kick extended RIGHT; rolling kick forward entry crouch; airborne rolling wheel kick with body rotated diagonally and foot kicking RIGHT.
Row 5: high forearm guard rising; high forearm guard braced; low knee/shin guard lifting; low knee/shin guard braced; small impact recoil torso; large impact recoil bending backward.
Row 6: falling backward knocked off feet; KO lying horizontally on ground, head left feet right; recovering crouch one knee near ground; victory fist raised; respectful standing karate bow; landing crouch.
Ensure each pose is a usable isolated sprite and the grid is complete.
headPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: modular head sprites for the supplied Kyokushin fighting-game body sheets. Reference 1 is adult MALE body; reference 2 is adult FEMALE body. Match exactly their face proportions, warm olive skin, shaded hand-inked arcade illustration, crisp dark contours. Produce a complete transparent RGBA sprite atlas, 5 columns by 4 rows, exactly TWENTY separate heads, each head centered in a generously spaced equal grid cell, no overlapping, no labels, no grid, no text, no shoulders or clothing. Include head, hair and a tiny neck stump only. All hair is dark brown, with coherent cool highlights.
Rows 1 and 2 same original adult masculine face, rows 3 and 4 same original adult feminine face. Five distinct hairstyles per sex, with exact column meanings shared across rows: column1 short neat cropped hair (female pixie crop); column2 swept side-part quiff (female side-swept short bob); column3 short compact curly hair; column4 medium-length hair pulled into a short ponytail behind head (female ponytail); column5 very close buzz cut with visible dark stubble.
Row1: the five MALE heads facing RIGHT in a three-quarter side view, no beard, focused calm fighting expression. Keep eyes, nose, chin at same location and head size in each cell regardless of hairstyle.
Row2: those same five MALE heads viewed from back-right three-quarter, exact hairstyle match to row1.
Row3: those five FEMALE heads facing RIGHT in a three-quarter side view, focused calm fighting expression. Keep eyes, nose, chin at same location and head size in each cell.
Row4: those same five FEMALE heads viewed from back-right three-quarter, exact hairstyle match to row3.
No floating face pieces: each head is intact including skin/head/hair/ears/nose/chin. Transparent background only. Maximum quality and consistent registered head scale.
